Evan B: Follow-up from today's allocator sync. Proposing a concise lease handshake to reduce races: orchestrator owns topology and global safety, scaler owns short-lived lease lifecycle (prewarm/active). Trying to keep responsibilities small and well-defined.

Ritika K: Nice. Can you sketch the state transitions and who has final eviction authority?

Evan B: Scaler lease states: REQUESTED -> PREWARM -> ACTIVE -> RELEASED. Orch node states: FREE -> RESERVED -> RETIRING. Final eviction decision stays with orchestrator. Scaler can request preempt_priority but orch enforces fairness.

Sam K: For admission responses, return admission_status {ALLOW, SOFT_THROTTLE, QUEUE_BURST, DENY} plus a short reason_code like "headroom_low". That lets scaler fallback to a smaller model or reduce batch size.

Jen L: Observability: emit lease_id and timestamps (req_ts, grant_ts, prewarm_done_ts, active_ts, release_ts) and decision_rationale (<=256 chars). Console needs a single correlation id per lease.

Ritika K: Edge-case: active lease during drain while KV cache still hot. Proposal: Release(lease_id, expected_release_ts) -> orch replies {ACK, ACK_WITH_GRACE_MS, FORCE_REVOKE}. FORCE_REVOKE emits kv_evict metric and triggers fallback routing. Limit grace per tenant.

Evan B: Agreed. Also add probe_cooldown_seconds (default 45s) and failed_prewarm_backoff_ms to avoid noisy repeated prewarms. Orch can return suggested_backoff_ms in denial.

Sam K: Minimal RPC sketch: 
```
RequestLease(tenant_id,demand_est,preempt_priority) -> {status,lease_id,ttl_ms,admission_status,reason_code,assigned_node}
KeepAlive(lease_id) -> {status,new_ttl_ms}
Release(lease_id,expected_release_ts) -> {status,grace_ms}
OrchEvents(stream) -> {lease_granted,lease_revoked,headroom_update}
```

Jen L: Also tag grants with billing_tag so prewarm time is billable and can be reconciled. And include assigned_node so telemetry maps to GPU metrics.

Ritika K: Simulation ask: I'll run a contested-headroom sim mixing reserved-credit tenants and burst tenants to measure fairness. Sam, can you add unit tests that fuzz simultaneous RequestLease calls? Jen, will wire lease traces to Console mocks.

orch-bot: autoscaler-staging: canary deploy of branch "lease-handshake-compact" succeeded :white_check_mark:

Evan B: I'll author a short RFC with the proto draft and state diagram, include config knobs and admission codes. Target review by EOW. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
